learning_objective: 🎯 We will explore how to draw beautiful, swirling dresses and big, expressive smiles to show extreme happiness!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: When we dance for joy, our smiles get huge! We can draw curved lines for the mouth and little stars in the eyes to show real happiness.
If someone spins while dancing, their skirt or shirt flies out like a bell or a triangle. We can fill these shapes with colorful dots and stripes!

fun_activity.title: 🎨 The Twirling Dancer
fun_activity.instructions: Draw a girl or boy spinning around in a big circle. Color their clothes using two different colors to show a beautiful pattern!

quick_recap: ⭐ A big smile and bright eyes make our drawn characters look joyful.
⭐ Spinning creates bell-like shapes in clothes that are fun to draw.
⭐ Colors can show our happy feelings on the paper.
